notes.title: Version 1.0.8 patch
notes.content:
Version 1.0.8

UI Improvements:

- Added a note in the smelter and factory windows indicating that the ingredients must be placed in the planet or station inventory.

Bug fixes:

- The starting ship for a new game will now depend on the difficulty level.  Games started on easier difficulties will start the game with a better ship.  This helps players who thought it was too difficult on very easy difficulty.  Also updated some tutorial text to account for the different starting ships.

- Fixed the volume for medium and large fuel tanks.  The volumes for these modules were too high, making them not worth getting.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 patch
notes.content:
[u]Version 1.0.7[/u]

[b]UI Improvements:[/b]

- Added a note in the galaxy generator loading panel to tell the player wait if the loading bar appears stuck.  It's not frozen, it just takes longer on some computers to generate a large galaxy.

- Added the key binding for opening the galaxy map to the message that appears when the player presses the hyperspace button and no destination is selected.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

- Changed the default volume levels to 50%.

- When boarding and capturing a robotic ship and later boarding and capturing a non-robotic ship, the Enter button failed to turn off.  This bug has been fixed and the Enter button turns off when it's supposed to.

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 patch
notes.content:
Version 1.0.6

New feature:

- Higher resolutions up to 3840 x 2160 are available now!  The resolution can be changed in the game options.

Bug fixes:

- The wrong message appeared when trying to upgrade a building and there were insufficient resources.  The correct message appears now.

- The building tooltip and faction relations tooltip were showing up in the wrong positions in certain screen resolutions.  The tooltips now appear correctly in all resolutions.

- The messages above the speedometer were appearing in the wrong location in certain screen resolutions.  The messages now appe3ar correctly in all resolutions.

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 patch
notes.content:
[u]Version 1.0.5[/u]

[b]New feature:[/b]

- Ships can now be sold in shipyards!

[b]UI Improvements:[/b]

- Prevented the quick start guide panel from closing too soon for people to notice it.

- Added a note to the tutorial that indicates planets, moons and stations can be selected by clicking.

- Added an explanation for how cloaking works in smuggling mission instructions.

- Enabled swapping ships while landed.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

- Fixed a bug that caused the game to get stuck in the loading screen after conquering certain planets.

- Fixed a bug that causes some keys to become inactive every once in a while.

- Disabled the transfer inventory to ship button and dropdown when there is only one ship in the player fleet.  This prevents an error when clicking on the button when there is no ship selected in the dropdown.

tags.feature: - Ships can now be sold in shipyards!
- Enabled swapping ships while landed.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 patch
notes.content:
[u]Version 1.0.4[/u]

[b]UI Improvements:[/b]

- You can now select which ship in your fleet to configure in the mechanic shop.  There is no need to launch the fleet and swap ships anymore to configure a different ship.  Just select the ship from the dropdown and configure it.  The currently piloted ship is selected by default.

- Added messages indicating a day has passed when launching the fleet and after jumping to hyperspace.

- Added a message after buying a ship that explains how to swap ships and that crew needs to be hired for the new ship.

- Added they keyboard shortcut for selecting closest hostile target to the message that says enemy fleet detected.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

- Modules can now be installed directly on any ship in your fleet while buying them from the mechanic shop, without putting them in your cargo bay.  You also have the option of not installing it and sending it to your cargo bay.  This solves the problem of not having enough cargo space to buy the modules to expand your cargo space.

- Fixed the cargo indicator which was not updating immediately after swapping ships.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 patch
notes.content:
[u]Version 1.0.3[/u]

[b]UI Improvements:[/b]
- Planets, moons and stations are clickable now!  They can be selected just by left-clicking on them.  The old way of selecting them by using [U], [I] and [Y] is still available.  Shooting is disabled when left-clicking on a planet, moon or station.

- A new cargo indicator was added to display the player ship's cargo volume.  It is next to the crew indicator.

- The target info panel now shows the keyboard shortcuts for Land, Hail and Board depending on what type of target is selected.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
- Fixed a bug that prevented hailing a ship if a planet was selected before the ship.

- A new cargo indicator was added to display the player ship's cargo volume.  It is next to the crew indicator.
- The target info panel now shows the keyboard shortcuts for Land, Hail and Board depending on what type of target is selected.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 patch
notes.content:
[u]Version 1.0.2[/u]

[b]UI Improvements:[/b]

- Added arrows to the galaxy map to help the player find the current location and active mission location when they are outside the map's view window.

- Added pan and zoom instruction notes to the galaxy map.

- Added a button to center the galaxy map on the active mission.

- Added a button to center the galaxy map on the mission currently being viewed.  This will help players determine where the mission goes before accepting it.  This button is in the mission details window.

- Added a note that indicates when a new story mission is available and points to the accepted mission list button.

- Added a note to the survey mission instructions explaining that to conduct a survey, the player only needs to travel to the destination.

- Added a note that indicates which mission was completed in the mission completion dialog.

- Added notes to the factory and smelter explaining that the Apply button sets the recipe and the factory and smelter will produce products based on the passing days, not instantly.

- Added a color code legend under the planet building list to help players determine which buildings can be entered.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

- Forced an asteroid belt to spawn in the starting system to make it easier for new players.

- Removed the return leg from most HQ missions to reduce grind.  Some of them still have a return leg due to the type of mission requiring it in order to make sense.

- If a mission is completed and it has a return leg, the return destination is now shown in the Active Mission yellow text on the top left of the screen.

- When a mission is aborted, the yellow mission instructions on the top left would still display the aborted mission.  Now it will display "Active Mission: None" after a mission is aborted.

- If a mission is completed and it has a return leg, the return destination is now shown in the Active Mission yellow text on the top left of the screen.
- When a mission is aborted, the yellow mission instructions on the top left would still display the aborted mission.  Now it will display "Active Mission: None" after a mission is aborted.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 patch
notes.content:
[u]Version 1.0.1[/u]

[b]UI Improvements:[/b]

- Added max and min buttons for jettisoning cargo and transferring cargo between ships and the current planet the player landed on.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

- Fixed bug that prevented installation of generators on a ship that consumes more power than it generates.

- Fixed bug that prevented dying when ship consumes more power than it generates and the ship battery runs out after a passing day.
